narrative: The tech landscape is heavily influenced by AI's rapid expansion, leading to concerns over data retention, ethical guardrails, and immense energy demands for new data centers. Simultaneously, public skepticism towards AI is emerging, notably from recent graduates. Amidst these shifts, advancements continue in space exploration, and consumer platforms are introducing more user control over algorithms.

highlights.title: AWS Bedrock to require sharing data with Anthropic for Mythos and future models
highlights.whyItMatters: This reveals growing requirements for data retention by AI developers (Anthropic) for safety, but raises privacy concerns as data leaves AWS's security boundary, impacting enterprise users.

highlights.title: Microsoft, like, totally gets why students are booing AI-pilled graduation speakers
highlights.whyItMatters: This reflects significant public backlash and skepticism, particularly among new graduates, towards the uncritical embrace of AI, prompting tech giants to address this sentiment.

highlights.title: Why everyone’s an energy company now
highlights.whyItMatters: Illustrates the profound impact of AI data centers on global energy demand, pushing diverse companies, including automakers, to invest heavily in energy storage and power solutions.

highlights.title: NASA assigns crew for Artemis III, sets aggressive timeline for flying it
highlights.whyItMatters: Signals concrete progress and ambitious timelines for NASA's lunar return mission, highlighting ongoing commitment to deep space human exploration.

highlights.title: You can just tell the Instagram algorithm what you want now
highlights.whyItMatters: Represents a move towards greater user control and transparency over social media algorithms, potentially mitigating concerns about curated content and 'algorithm traps.'

topics.name: AI Data & Ethics
topics.summary: Concerns over AI model training data retention, user privacy, content rights, and the ethical guardrails applied to frontier models are prominent, alongside public skepticism about AI's societal impact.

topics.name: AI Innovation & Investment
topics.summary: The rapid development of new AI models and tools continues, with significant investment in AI coding agents and enterprise applications, while companies explore faster text generation and local AI capabilities.

topics.name: Space Exploration & Fusion
topics.summary: NASA is advancing ambitious missions like Artemis III to the Moon and utilizing the Webb Telescope for scientific discoveries, while private sector companies like Avalanche Energy are making strides in fusion power development.

topics.name: Digital Infrastructure & Energy
topics.summary: The immense power requirements of AI data centers are transforming the energy landscape, leading to new data center deals and prompting companies across various sectors to invest in energy storage and efficient cloud infrastructure.

topics.name: Consumer Tech & Platform Updates
topics.summary: Major platforms are introducing features for enhanced user control over content algorithms and new functionalities for smart devices, while addressing security concerns and adapting business models.
